title: RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das: Making Your Digital Payments Safer
description: RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das recently emphasized the central bank's commitment to strengthening digital payment security. This focus comes as more Indians use.

faq.q: What is the RBI's role in digital payments?
faq.a: The RBI regulates, supervises, and develops payment and settlement systems in India, ensuring their safety, efficiency, and accessibility for all users.

faq.q: What should I do if I face digital fraud?
faq.a: Immediately contact your bank's customer care to block your account/card and report the fraudulent transaction. Also, file a complaint on the National Cybercrime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in) or call helpline 1930.

faq.q: Are all digital payments covered by these measures?
faq.a: Yes, the RBI's regulations generally cover all regulated digital payment instruments and platforms, including UPI, mobile wallets, internet banking, and card payments.

faq.q: How can I stay safe online?
faq.a: Always use strong, unique passwords, enable multi-factor authentication, be cautious of suspicious links or messages (phishing), and never share your OTP, PIN, or banking passwords with anyone.
